test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a public sector bank in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Overseas Bank.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Public sector banks are majority-owned by **the government.**
 
• They operate under the regulatory framework of the** Reserve Bank of India (RBI).**
 
• They provide various services, including loans, savings accounts, and government schemes.
 
• **Promote Financial Inclusion: **Public sector banks focus on extending banking services to rural and underserved areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Private sector banks are owned by **private individuals** or corporations, distinguishing them from public sector banks, which are government-owned.
 
• Prominent private sector banks include **HDFC Bank**, **ICICI Bank**,** Axis Bank**, and** Kotak Mahindra Bank**.
 
• These banks are regulated by the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI),** ensuring adherence to banking norms and guidelines.
 
• Private sector banks often lead in digital banking solutions, offering advanced mobile banking services and customer-centric financial products.
